bosses.name: The Wall
bosses.battleInsight: Patience opens what force cannot; watch for the return after a perfect defense.

segments.trace:
I learned the shape of every blow,
and answered each with stone.
The world called this protection.
I called it standing alone.
segments.fracture:
No wound could pass the boundary,
so neither could a hand.
I raised my strength between us
until none could understand.
segments.echo:
Yet every strike I turned away
returned with something more:
a rhythm asking quietly
what walls are truly for.
segments.ascension:
At last I leave one opening
where once I sealed them all.
For strength is not remaining stone—
but choosing when to fall.

bosses.name: The Rocket
bosses.battleInsight: Do not chase raw speed; anticipate the lane The Rocket has already committed to.

segments.trace:
I burned the ground behind me
before it learned my name.
The horizon fled before my feet;
I praised the fleeing flame.
segments.fracture:
Each summit became smaller
before my pulse grew still.
I mistook the lack of distance
for the proof of greater will.
segments.echo:
But speed can cross a universe
and never learn its size.
A trail remembers where I was;
it cannot tell me why.
segments.ascension:
So let one star remain ahead,
not conquered, only bright.
I need not own the horizon
to keep it in my sight.

bosses.name: The Shepherd
bosses.battleInsight: Its guidance is also control; resist the obvious route and create your own angle.

segments.trace:
I bent the paths toward safety
and taught the lights to lead.
No wandering step was wasted;
no garden grew from need.
segments.fracture:
I knew where every road should end,
so choice became a flaw.
The gentlest hand may still become
a quiet kind of law.
segments.echo:
Then one small current left my field
and crossed the stones alone.
I watched it find, by losing me,
a destination of its own.
segments.ascension:
Now pathways curve but do not close;
my lanterns merely glow.
To guide is not to choose the road—
it is to let one go.

bosses.name: The Trickster
bosses.battleInsight: Trust motion more than appearances; the safest-looking pattern may be the deception.

segments.trace:
I hung ten doors upon one wall
and painted nine as true.
The clever laughed and chose at once;
I changed the hinges too.
segments.fracture:
I made uncertainty a crown
so none could fool me first.
But every joke that hid my face
made being known feel worse.
segments.echo:
One mirror failed to flatter me;
it simply held its place.
I waited for the trick to bloom
and found my waiting face.
segments.ascension:
So keep one door without a maze,
one answer without art.
The finest trick I never learned
was how to hide my heart.

bosses.name: The Furnace
bosses.battleInsight: Momentum feeds the Furnace; interrupt its rhythm before pressure becomes heat.

segments.trace:
I fed the fire another sun
and asked it to endure.
Each hotter flame became the proof
that hotter still was pure.
segments.fracture:
The forge obeyed until its glow
outshone the hands that made it.
I called the ruin sacrifice
because I could not name it.
segments.echo:
Beneath the roar, one ember waits,
content to simply be.
It warms the iron without demanding
all that it can see.
segments.ascension:
I close the gate before the blaze
can swallow forge and name.
The highest heat is not the test—
but what survives the flame.

bosses.name: The Trapper
bosses.battleInsight: The cage depends on predictable collisions; vary your returns and make its certainty expensive.

segments.trace:
I counted every possible step
and wired the spaces thin.
Before a foot could choose its path,
I knew where it had been.
segments.fracture:
No accident could enter here;
no chance escaped my sight.
I made a perfect cage of cause
and slept inside at night.
segments.echo:
Then something struck the seventh gate
at an unmeasured degree.
The flaw was not within my trap—
the trapped thing had been me.
segments.ascension:
I leave one circuit incomplete,
one outcome undefined.
A door is more than open space;
it is permission to change one's mind.

bosses.name: The Traveler
bosses.battleInsight: Portals tempt prediction; track the return path rather than the destination that draws your eye.

segments.trace:
I kept a thousand worlds in reach
and slept in none for long.
Each gate became a promise
that elsewhere I belonged.
segments.fracture:
I crossed until departure
was the only home I knew.
Every world remained unfinished;
every farewell stayed new.
segments.echo:
Between two broken passages
I heard no portal sing.
The silence had no destination—
and did not ask a thing.
segments.ascension:
Perhaps the road is not a home,
nor home the journey's end.
I choose one sky to stand beneath
before I leave again.

bosses.name: The Phantom
bosses.battleInsight: Afterimages preserve old intentions; follow what changes, not what lingers.

segments.trace:
The hall remembers every step
though no one walks it now.
Moonlight keeps my outlines
where time forgot me how.
segments.fracture:
I learned to leave before goodbye,
to fade before the pain.
Soon absence was the only shape
I knew how to maintain.
segments.echo:
But echoes are not emptiness;
they prove a sound was there.
Even broken glass holds moonlight
without pretending to repair.
segments.ascension:
So let my final afterimage
remain, then disappear.
To vanish is not to be nothing—
it means I once was here.

bosses.name: The Duelist
bosses.battleInsight: The Duelist rewards precision over panic; every committed strike creates an equally precise opening.

segments.trace:
I drew a line across the storm
and waited at its end.
An equal standing opposite
was neither foe nor friend.
segments.fracture:
I sharpened every victory
until I could not see
whether I sought a worthy rival
or someone worthy of me.
segments.echo:
Then steel-blue thunder answered red,
and neither sky withdrew.
Respect was born between the strikes
where certainty broke through.
segments.ascension:
I leave the line unbroken now,
but cross it without shame.
The rival who can wound my pride
may also forge my name.

bosses.name: The Master
bosses.battleInsight: Every lesson returns here; mastery is recognizing old patterns after their colors and timing have changed.

segments.trace:
I gathered every scar and road,
each gate, each flame, each fall.
I placed them in a single hall
and thought I knew them all.
segments.fracture:
Knowledge hardened into form;
my answers learned to stay.
The student changed between my words
while I preserved yesterday.
segments.echo:
Then black fire crossed the archive
and spared what could still bend.
A lesson kept from changing
has already met its end.
segments.ascension:
So take from me no final truth,
no perfect, finished art.
A master leaves the door unlocked
and lets the student start.

bosses.name: The Sovereign
bosses.battleInsight: The Sovereign controls symmetry; watch for the tiny contradiction where reflection stops obeying.

segments.trace:
I set the heavens into pairs
and crowned the dark with light.
Each opposite received its place;
each wrong reflected right.
segments.fracture:
I ruled until perfection
made every answer mine.
Yet nothing new can enter worlds
where all must match design.
segments.echo:
Beneath the eclipse, the mirror moved
one heartbeat out of time.
A flaw no law had summoned
became a living sign.
segments.ascension:
I do not break the mirrored court;
I let the difference stay.
A crown that cannot yield its shape
will never greet the day.

bosses.name: Shadow Box
bosses.battleInsight: Your opponent inherits your habits; break your own rhythm before it learns you completely.

segments.trace:
I met a motion shaped like mine
behind the darkened glass.
It knew the turns I favored
and the angles I would pass.
segments.fracture:
I blamed the shadow for my faults,
then watched it blame me too.
Each flaw became an inheritance;
each answer something new.
segments.echo:
It was never merely copying—
it listened as I changed.
The stranger grew familiar
while the familiar grew strange.
segments.ascension:
I leave no shadow conquered here,
no lesser self behind.
I taught my echo how to move;
my echo changed my mind.

bosses.name: Mirror Arena
bosses.battleInsight: Symmetry exposes assumptions; what looks identical may answer differently once you act.

segments.trace:
Two heavens touched the skyglass,
blue answering rose in kind.
I searched the mirrored distance
for the border between minds.
segments.fracture:
Each side returned the other's light,
yet neither stayed the same.
Reflection kept the silhouette
but never kept the flame.
segments.echo:
I asked which image came before,
which echo followed through.
The water held both questions
and divided neither view.
segments.ascension:
At last the glass reflects no halves,
no first and second star.
Two lights may share one horizon
without forgetting what they are.
